scope: Exact reviewed public-comment display summaries only. Existing transcript/person identities are not changed. Ambiguous/unconfirmed names fall back to a resident label. Official Langford street spellings and one source-reviewed alias supply location labels; unsupported locations are omitted.
preservation: Every speaker position/order and all substantive point/topic/overview diffs were inspected; policy identifiers, years, monetary amounts, and counts remain. All 33 summaries are idempotent.
validation_limits: Display-name spelling support is not acoustic identity validation. Certification applies to the exact plan, not every possible future ASR address grammar.
